cs.t: I traveled across Asia for 3 years. I had a Mission Workshop Radian and attached Spar which I loved. As for data you should expect to do most of your work in co-working or coffee shop spaces as cellular data still doesn't cut it if you're on video calls all day. As for the rest of my tech set-up (loosely):. * Bose in ear noise cancelling headphones with microphone * 2xPhones (A pixel 2 main and Huawei P30 Light backup) this is because I'd be screwed if I didn't have a phone. * Lenovo X1 * RAV 90w charger with two USBC ports * iPad pro (downloaded Netflix content, games, books) * Earpod Pros * A 1000mah charger I got as conference swag * Misc cables/micro SD cards Largely I considered a drink or food every two hours as rent for coffee shop space where I would do bandwidth heavy work (and charging). Another 2-4 hours of work I would hotspot my phone and largely use ssh.
